scenes.text: Grandma kept her porch light on every single night.
"So you can always find your way home," she said.
Then I moved to the city on the far hill. Years went by.
Every call ended the same way: "The light is still on."
I kept saying "next month." Then "next year."
This winter, I finally walked back down the valley.
The light was still on. And so was she.

end: Go see the people who leave the light on for you.
